content: Decentralize, grow, and secure the Solana network. - Solana Foundation | Product Hunt Solana Foundation Decentralize, grow, and secure the Solana network. 767 followers Decentralize, grow, and secure the Solana network. 767 followers Visit website Engineering & Development • Web3 Solana Foundation is a non-profit organization dedicated to the decentralization, growth, and security of the Solana ecosystem. Free Launch tags: API • Open Source • Developer Tools Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 4 Day Rank Upvote • 289 points Follow Solana Foundation Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info solana.foundation GitHub Solana Foundation Info Launched in 2026 View 2 launches Forum p/solanafndn Subscribe Sign in Social LinkedIn X Previous Solana Foundation Launches Surfpool Where developers start their Solana journey Launched on February 28th, 2026 1 114 Reviews Most Informative View all No reviews yet Be the first to leave a review for Solana Foundation Leave a review Wispr Flow: Dictation That Works Everywhere — Stop typing. Start speaking. 4x faster. Stop typing. Start speaking. 4x faster. Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Samir Asadov Pay-per-request, no API keys, agent-native — this is one of those primitives that quietly unlocks a category of products that just couldn't ship before. The thing I'm most curious about is the failure mode: what happens when an agent gets into a feedback loop and burns through 10,000 micro-payments in a minute? I run a small AI alerts product around prediction markets called PolyMind, and the autonomous-decisions-on-noisy-signals problem is brutal even at fixed cost per call. With pay-per-request you've added a real money knob to the loop. Are you exposing budget caps / circuit breakers at the agent level, or leaving that to the agent runtime? Cool launch either way — congrats. Upvote (2) Report Share 17h ago Ludo Galabru Solana Foundation Maker Thanks @samir_asadov ! At the moment, we're at a stage where agents clearly need supervision when they want to spend. Currently, every spending attempt is prompting an OS system authorization - (using TouchID on macOS - so Apple Pay like experience). The next step is "here is 1$, it's valid for 1 hour, whatever is left after automatically returns to me". We'll progressively give more knobs to play with to users / developers / agents. Upvote (2) Report Share 16h ago fmerian Hunter @ludovic any public roadmap btw? Upvote Report Share 15h ago fmerian Hunter [ Pay.sh ] unlocks a category of products that just couldn't ship before.
